Create a sparse Korean hanok compound centered on a large flat square platform of pale gray checkerboard tiles, surrounded by open blue sky. Arrange roughly five connected or closely spaced single-story timber buildings around small courtyards and narrow passages. Use white plaster panels, brown exposed beams, low brick bases, lattice windows and doors, and sweeping dark tiled roofs with raised eaves. Include a recessed entry passage with a heavy metal-studded double wooden gate. Place two or three detached pavilion-like outbuildings around the core, varying roof orientation while keeping the structures rectilinear and aligned. Leave broad empty tiled margins and exclude vegetation, furnishings, people, roads, fences, and surrounding landscape.

Rebuild the place described above on the 200 m x 200 m plate, at the density

deterministic_rule_draft.prompt: Create a sparse Korean hanok compound centered on a large flat square platform of pale gray checkerboard tiles, surrounded by open blue sky. Arrange roughly five connected or closely spaced single-story timber buildings around small courtyards and narrow passages. Use white plaster panels, brown exposed beams, low brick bases, lattice windows and doors, and sweeping dark tiled roofs with raised eaves. Include a recessed entry passage with a heavy metal-studded double wooden gate. Place two or three detached pavilion-like outbuildings around the core, varying roof orientation while keeping the structures rectilinear and aligned. Leave broad empty tiled margins and exclude vegetation, furnishings, people, roads, fences, and surrounding landscape.

Include a recessed entry passage with a heavy metal-studded double wooden gate.
Place two or three detached pavilion-like outbuildings around the core, varying roof orientation while keeping the structures rectilinear and aligned.
Leave broad empty tiled margins and exclude vegetation, furnishings, people, roads, fences, and surrounding landscape.

major_clause_coverage.source_text: Create a sparse Korean hanok compound centered on a large flat square platform of pale gray checkerboard tiles, surrounded by open blue sky.
Arrange roughly five connected or closely spaced single-story timber buildings around small courtyards and narrow passages.
Use white plaster panels, brown exposed beams, low brick bases, lattice windows and doors, and sweeping dark tiled roofs with raised eaves.
Include a recessed entry passage with a heavy metal-studded double wooden gate.
Place two or three detached pavilion-like outbuildings around the core, varying roof orientation while keeping the structures rectilinear and aligned.
Leave broad empty tiled margins and exclude vegetation, furnishings, people, roads, fences, and surrounding landscape.
